[message_id=684641 author=shoulderpain first=True]
I used Submit Prediction -> File Upload -> submission.zip to submit a model I trained locally.
My submission.zip is 3GB. If I make 5 submissions a day, this will quickly use up my Kaggle storage. 
Is it possible to delete the old submission.zip from Submissions to save space? Unlike notebook submissions, the file submissions are huge.

[message_id=3428587 author=shoulderpain first=False]
Now I switched to Datasets + notebook submission, as unused Datasets can be completely deleted. But I still want to delete the old submission.zip from Submissions because they're huge.
